sessionStart.bash: rel='scripts/log-session-start.sh'; for base in "$PWD/packages/copilot-cli-plugin" "$PWD" "$HOME/.copilot/installed-plugins/_direct/copilot-cli-plugin" "$HOME/.copilot/installed-plugins/_direct"/* "$HOME/.copilot/installed-plugins"/*/*; do [ -f "$base/plugin.json" ] || continue; grep -Eq '"name"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"omcp"' "$base/plugin.json" || continue; if [ -f "$base/$rel" ]; then exec bash "$base/$rel"; fi; done; printf '{"continue":true,"reason":"omcp hook script not found"}\n'
